generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate dummy pybind11 C++ binding code with a specified number of classes and random method signatures
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate dummy Boost.Python C++ binding code with a specified number of classes and random method signatures
benchmark_compilation_pybind11: benchmark pybind11 compilation time and output size across increasing class counts from 1 to 512
benchmark_compilation_boost: benchmark Boost.Python compilation time and output size across increasing class counts from 1 to 512
compare_binding_frameworks: compare pybind11 and Boost.Python compilation performance by generating and compiling equivalent dummy C++ modules
